name: ssh-tmux-second-device-baseline
purpose: Measure whether a second controller can attach to the same remote SSH/tmux session after the first controller terminates and observe new output
steps: Attach the primary simulator to a unique tmux session with a remote heartbeat
Record the latest heartbeat marker, then terminate the primary app
Attach the secondary simulator to the same tmux session
Verify a heartbeat marker later than the primary baseline is visible and a fresh terminal.ssh.ready event arrives
